findings.title: Punctuation at the wrong end
findings.message: "Due date: 3 November 2026 (24 Rabi' al-T…" runs right to left, so its last mark moves to the start.
findings.fix: Give the block the direction of its own text, with dir="ltr", dir="rtl" or dir="auto".

findings.title: No Arabic font in the stack
findings.message: Arabic falls back from Arial, sans-serif.
findings.fix: Load an Arabic family with @font-face or a font link and name it in the stack, for example "IBM Plex Sans Arabic".
